monster.bram_cattaram_entomb.desc: Mass Incarnates are thanaraks that have absorbed too much quasimorphic substance. As a result, they turn into motionless boulders for several millennia. Once they come back to themselves, however, they prove far stronger than their kin. All evidence suggests that Morax came into being in precisely this way.
monster.bram_cattaram_entomb.name: Mass Incarnate
monster.bram_cattaram_wall.desc: Defender of Morax’s sanctum. The Kataphrontarii are drawn from kataphrons who have never been reborn, and thus have never died. They are eternal sentinels at the border between the shades of unbeing and unbeing itself.
monster.bram_cattaram_wall.name: Kataphrontarius
monster.bram_flauros_acid_bloom.desc: When an Ard Rí breaks his geas, the Geas-Brehon appears in the night silence of Flauros. This being ensures that the ancient Ways of the dread bramfatura exact their debt from the transgressor.
monster.bram_flauros_acid_bloom.name: Geas-Brehon
monster.bram_flauros_druid.desc: About once every hundred thousand years, one of the Ard Rí finds the Black Crown of Flauros in the shadowed reaches of the woods. When he sets it upon his head, he becomes the Stag of Cruachan, uniting the strength of many, many thanedoms. The history of Flauros is a history of seeking and finding such crowns.
monster.bram_flauros_druid.name: Stag of Cruachan
monster.bram_flauros_falcon.desc: A funeral keener of Flauros. This quasimorph appears wherever there will soon be someone to mourn.
monster.bram_flauros_falcon.name: Badb
monster.bram_flauros_thorned_thicket.des: An exceedingly rare quasimorph from one of the secret fellowships of Flauros. This being carries the decrees of a hidden Ard Rí named Volos along the roads of Flauros.
monster.bram_mars_brass_feed.desc: One of the Barakunarashi who tried to seize the Vacant Throne when Urparp vanished from the bramfatura. Now, guided by the lugal’s will, the Pretender atones for the sin of his temptation.
monster.bram_mars_brass_feed.name: Pretender
monster.bram_mars_bulls_horns.desc: When Urparp vanished from Ur, petrified into a stone idol on the surface of Mars, the Vacant Throne became the emblem of his sovereignty. Vacant Throne Mandates are quasimorphs who have concentrated within themselves the knowledge of what the eternal lugal’s kingship is, and what it is meant for. The Vacant Throne is the reflection of the Red and Gold Throne. And if the lugal once made a mistake, he will correct it.
monster.bram_mars_bulls_horns.name: Vacant Throne Mandate
monster.bram_mars_molten_jet.desc: Gavvakh Mashkims are libators in whom the Tyrant’s appetite has hardened into office. They no longer hunt flesh, they audit it, seize it, and deliver it screaming into the lugal reserve.
monster.bram_mars_molten_jet.name: Gavvakh Mashkim
monster.bram_mars_wrath_of_ur.desc: Guardian of the gates of Ur. The bramfatura of Mars contains many such gates: passages between its layers, the chambers of its higher hierarchs, hidden places in the desert, and assembly halls where gavvakh and other substances are exchanged. Each passage has its own Ganzer Galla assigned to it.
monster.bram_mars_wrath_of_ur.name: Ganzer Galla
monster.bram_mercury_arcane_escape.desc: A Sultan who has completed Shartmakhum’s desert path through annihilation of the self. His body has shed the ancient shape of the jinn and become a measure of perfection. Such Sultans spend most of their time learning to read names, yet when they sense a source of gavvakh, they rush toward it without hesitation.
monster.bram_mercury_arcane_escape.name: Kamil al-Fana
monster.bram_mercury_azure_shield.desc: A faithful Abd accepted into one of Shartmakhum’s war tariqas. The chain of obedience has been threaded through his subtle body. Every order from the elder quasimorphs reaches him as revelation, pain, and permission to kill.
monster.bram_mercury_azure_shield.name: Murid of the Silsila
monster.bram_mercury_disintegrate.desc: A Sultan who manages to break through the layers of Shartmakhum and touch the surface of Fukabirna becomes an Ifrit. In that moment, he gains extraordinary power over the quasimorphs of his bramfatura, though by then he has no use for it: he has begun to see the world in an entirely different way.
monster.bram_mercury_disintegrate.name: Ifrit
monster.bram_mercury_prism.desc: A Malāk who has plunged into Fukabirna’s fiery body and risen again unharmed above its surface becomes a Qarin al-Barzakh.
monster.bram_mercury_prism.name: Qarin al-Barzakh
monster.bram_moon_pain_wall.desc: A Nobilis who receives the most precious reward in Duggur — the kiss of Fokerma — becomes a Knight of Pain forever. Every movement within the bramfatura of the Moon is felt as a movement within his own thin body.
monster.bram_moon_pain_wall.name: Knight of Pain
monster.bram_moon_shrink_armor.desc: A Steel Servant who undergoes the sweet and agonizing process of atonement becomes a Bridled Knight. The pain he inflicts upon his victims returns to him, yet he experiences it as pleasure. In the name of Fokerma’s forgiveness, Bridled Knights can carve their way through entire fortresses across the black landscapes of Duggur.
monster.bram_moon_shrink_armor.name: Bridled Knight
monster.bram_olirna_cooled_rumble.desc: When the Samaya-Bound is sent to hunt, the golden halls of Olirna receive his tread in reverence, and death follows after him, so that gavvakh may pour from torn veins in uncommon abundance.
monster.bram_olirna_cooled_rumble.name: Samaya-Bound
monster.bram_olirna_glaciation.desc: Vajra-Dapon is a dapon whose discipline survived the ruin of everything he held dear. The vajra sealed within his thin body was meant to make him a protector, yet under Gagtungr’s will it became an unbreakable chain.
monster.bram_olirna_glaciation.name: Vajra-Dapon
monster.bram_ron_darkness.desc: Barounazaphylaxes are barounazes that have gathered too many shards of metamatter. Their bodies become reliquaries of alien wreckage, carrying the aftermath of catastrophes.
monster.bram_ron_darkness.name: Barounazophylax
monster.bram_ron_static_field.desc: Aknaromastiges are aknaraxes whose hatred has scoured the last remnants of will from their quasimorphic thin bodies.
monster.bram_ron_static_field.name: Aknaromastix
monster.bram_scrivnus_impaling_ring.desc: Gaols Incarnate are tarkaores who served Skrivnus until the prison walls entered the flesh of their thin bodies. Now they do not guard the eternal gaol from within its walls, they carry those walls with them.
monster.bram_scrivnus_impaling_ring.name: Gaol Incarnate
monster.bram_venus_coagulation_trap.desc: A sworn knight of one of the hidden knightly orders of Gannix, the bramfatura of Venus. This quasimorph has been granted the honor of bearing one of the rare Pacts of Gannix, so that he may always prove useful to his liege.
monster.bram_venus_coagulation_trap.name: Python Knight
monster.bram_venus_dismember.desc: A sworn knight of one of the hidden knightly orders of Gannix, the bramfatura of Venus. This quasimorph has been granted the honor of bearing one of the rare Pacts of Gannix, so that he may always prove useful to his liege.
monster.bram_venus_dismember.name: Spider Knight
monster.bram_venus_spike.desc: The Unowned Sun is Gannix’s utterly free taltnom. He stands outside every hierarchy and almost every bond, and believes that this freedom must be carried to all things around him. He annihilates every condition of unfreedom, even when the prison is the body, the future, or the soul itself.
monster.bram_venus_spike.name: Unowned Sun
monster.bruiser_SheduThousand_female.des: She knows how to extract suffering from every blow, reducing opponents to trembling shadows of their former selves.

monster.cattaram_baron.name: Thanarak
monster.cattaram_knight.desc: Knight of Cattaram, knighted by Morax himself. Eternal guardian of the borders between varying kinds of inexistence.

monster.cattaram_servitor.desc: The servant of Cattaram, staying in the eternal sleep. It carries out all orders with a blend of strange passivity and mysterious cunning.

monster.corporation_dog.desc: Space-bred tracker. These dogs sniff dissent as keenly as blood.
monster.corporation_dog.name: Corp Hound
monster.cyborg_battle.desc: A Warhead-class autonomous robot (AR) is an AI-driven humanoid robot specialised for close combat in space-station facilities. They play a prominent role in Solar System: many rich corporations use "warhs" as integral part of its security system. Warhead-class is one among numerous other types of battle robots. It is the original model of the RealWare corporation and most common type of ARs in the System.
monster.cyborg_battle.name: Warhead-class
monster.cyborg_recreation.desc: A Sheila-class autonomous robot (AR) is an AI-driven humanoid robot specialised for your pleasure only. Please contact your local distributor for brand of recommended lube. We wish you the best rest with your best purchase.
monster.cyborg_recreation.name: Sheila-class
monster.cyborg_worker.desc: Autonomous robot. A service machine that is used by corporations where living workers cannot be used. Robots are more expensive than humans, so corporations that care about profit margins only use them where it's necessary.
monster.cyborg_worker.name: AR
monster.ddr_ceo_female.desc: She used to sell dream-pills out of the trunk of her shuttle. Now she calibrates dosages for the entire anarcho-capitalist system. Believes the market will decide how much schizophrenia is too much.
monster.ddr_ceo_female.name: Nathalie Lettmann
monster.ddr_elite_female.desc: An elite Daydream Chems operator — squad lead and field tester of proprietary reagents. This kind of commander sets the pace, runs the defensive sector, and “sterilizes” rooms with in-house munitions.
monster.ddr_elite_female.name: Neutralizer
